narr: Broad east to southeast flow advected in monsoon moisture, which fueled thunderstorms over southern Nevada. Several storms produced flash flooding.
ev: Westbound Highway 164 was closed due to flooding.
Highway 95 was closed in both directions due to flooding.
Highway 266 was closed from Highway 168 to Highway 95. Rocks, debris, and mud four to six feet deep blocked a 30 mile stretch of the highway.
lsr: NEVADA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION REPORTED THAT WESTBOUND STATE ROUTE 164 WAS CLOSED DUE TO FLOODING. TIME ESTIMATED FROM RADAR.
NVDOT CLOSED US 95 IN BOTH DIRECTIONS NORTH OF SEARCHLIGHT DUE TO FLOODING.
ESMERALDA COUNTY SHERIFF REPORTED THAT THEY SHUT DOWN HIGHWAY 266 BETWEEN HIGHWAY 95 AND HIGHWAY 168.
